newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KAUBAMAJA 97 Q1 PROFIT 8.8 MLN EEK.
newsitem.headline: KAUBAMAJA 97 Q1 PROFIT 8.8 MLN EEK.

text.p: Tallinna Kaubamaja, one of the largest department stores in Estonia, said its 1997 first quarter pre-tax profit was 8.8 million kroons compared to 1996's first quarter profit of 7.1 million kroons.
The company's total first quarter turnover was 111 million kroons compared to 1996's 108 million kroons, the company said in a statement.
The company's total business income was 111.2 million kroons versus 107.9 million kroons.
Kaubamaja's salary bill increased from 1996 first quarter of 6.3 million kroons to 7.2 million kroons. Whiel social tax payments increase from 2.1 million kroons to 2.4 million kroons.
